answer_2.quote: We use cosine similarity to measure the similarity.

answer_3.quote: We experimented with the LLMs using zero-shot prompting and two prompts. One uses a more Technical language (TL): 'Which word is more phonetically similar to [ANCHOR]: [WORD1], [WORD2], [WORD3] or [WORD4]? Only respond with the correct word.'; the other uses more Layman's language (LL): 'Which word sounds more like [ANCHOR]: [WORD1], [WORD2], [WORD3] or [WORD4]? Only respond with the correct word.'
